reason: The v1 closed-loop prefix was governed by executed_prefix_seconds=0.16. At 15 Hz this equals 2.4 actions and cannot be executed exactly. The defect was found before any provider call, outcome-label access, prediction, or paid execution in this experiment.
scientific_legitimacy: The amendment repairs an internally impossible timing contract without using outcomes or model predictions. All endpoint thresholds remain unchanged except that the brittle literal monotonic-risk rule is replaced prospectively by the uncertainty-aware rule requested by the experiment owner.
changed_fields: executed_prefix_steps added as the positive-integer governing variable
executed_prefix_seconds_derived added and required to equal steps divided by 15
4, 8, and 16 step label-free pilot candidates and deterministic fallback selection added
pointwise monotonic abstention gate replaced by empirical plus isotonic session-clustered uncertainty-aware risk rule
collapse detection, retention, reliability penalty, and abstention categories added
parallel WAM arms and visible-skeleton versus scene-masked attribution made explicit
pinned DROID raw-action transformation and no-external-normalization result added
campaign cost and concurrency ceilings added
